# HeatPumpAtlasUSA

> US heat pump cost, heat pump installation cost, mini split installation cost, heat pump rebates, and a free heat pump cost calculator.

HeatPumpAtlasUSA models whether a heat pump pays in a given US home using EIA electricity and gas prices, NOAA heating degree days, Census fuel mix, and a short list of rebate programs verified by hand. The calculator publishes losing cases. It does not assume a heat pump always saves money.

## Cost pages

- [Heat pump cost](https://heatpumpatlasusa.com/): National heat pump cost ranges and the switching calculator
- [Heat pump installation cost](https://heatpumpatlasusa.com/heat-pump-cost/): Installed cost by system type, $9,500 to $22,000 for a typical ducted system
- [Mini split installation cost](https://heatpumpatlasusa.com/mini-split-cost/): Per-zone ductless pricing
- [Heat pump operating cost](https://heatpumpatlasusa.com/heat-pump-operating-cost/): Annual running cost vs gas, oil and propane by state
- [Heat pump water heater cost](https://heatpumpatlasusa.com/heat-pump-water-heater-cost/): Hybrid water heater pricing and payback
- [Electrical panel upgrade cost](https://heatpumpatlasusa.com/electrical-panel-upgrade-cost/): When a heat pump forces a 200 amp upgrade
- [Heat pump cost calculator](https://heatpumpatlasusa.com/calculator/): ZIP-level installed cost, operating cost, open rebates and payback
